blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than in correctness. Several reward models favor the construction even over quality-matched variants, an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it, and both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency in open-weight models. We hope this work encourages the development of models attentive to the appropriateness of their expressions.
blocks.zh: 模式-书面文本中反复出现的表达方式往往被视作机器作者的签名,但大多数表达方式都具有合法功能. 这样的表达式是否是一个tic,取决于模型是否知道何时需要. 这种对适当性的判断是沟通能力的核心,对于语言模式来说,基本上还没有经过审查。 我们通过普通话的修补性建筑灌木X,ershi Y("不是X,而是Y")来研究. 我们借鉴了Gricean的务实主义和纠正性否定,引入了一个决策树,通过测试上下文是否使X成为活的替代物,拒绝X是否具有信息性,将用途归类为实质性的,可选的或有缺陷的. 5个商业模型使用构造为人类参考物的2.5至9.2倍的密度. 在307种附加说明的用途中,只有1.30%有缺陷,52.8%是可选的,即正确但不需要,因此模型在适当性方面远远低于正确性。 一些奖励模式倾向于构建,甚至优于质量匹配的变体,一个LLM评委倾向于即便在上下文不允许的情况下,它,同时监督的微调和偏好优化都倾向于在开放量模型中提高它的频率. 我们希望这项工作能鼓励开发注意其表达方式适当性的模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models can now resolve real-world issues and complete multi-step tasks with tools ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) , and a growing share of the text people read is machine-generated. In Grice ’s ( 1975 ) account of cooperative conversation, a contribution should be as informative as the exchange requires and no more, and it should be relevant to the purpose at hand. An entirely accurate response can still fall short of these maxims by elaborating beyond what was asked or by addressing a question that was never at issue. Conformity to these maxims is therefore part of model quality alongside factual accuracy.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型现在可以解决现实世界的问题并用工具完成多步任务(Jimenez等,2024;Yao等,2024),阅读文字的人越来越多是机器生成的. 在格里斯(1975年)关于合作对话的叙述中,贡献应该像交流所要求的那样翔实,而不是更多的,并且应该与手头的目的相关. 完全准确的答复仍然可能无法达到这些准则,因为所问问题的范围以外,或涉及一个从未引起过争论的问题。 因此,符合这些准则是模式质量的一部分,同时也是事实准确性的一部分。

blocks.en: Model-written text also contains expressions that recur often enough for readers to treat them as signatures of machine authorship ( Juzek and Ward, 2025 ; Shaib et al., 2025 ) . Most of these expressions are ordinary resources of the language, and human writers use the same devices where the discourse calls for them. Whether a recurring expression amounts to a tic thus depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. Hymes (1972) placed this knowledge at the core of communicative competence, as a judgment of whether an utterance is appropriate to its context, separate from whether it is grammatically possible and from how often it is in fact produced.
blocks.zh: 模型书写文本也包含经常被重复的表达方式,使读者能够把它们当作机器作者的签名(Juzek和Ward,2025;Shaib等,2025.). 这些表达方式大多是语言的普通资源,而人类的作家们在说出这些表达方式时使用相同的设备. 因此,反复出现的表达式是否相当于tic,取决于模型是否知道何时需要。 Hymes(1972年)将这种知识置于交流能力的核心,作为判断一种言论是否适合其上下文,与语法上是否可行以及实际制作的频率不同.

blocks.en: Research on language models, however, has mostly approached pragmatics from the listener’s side, testing whether models recover implicatures and presuppositions ( Ruis et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Sravanthi et al., 2024 ) , and recent comparisons show that competence in comprehension does not transfer to appropriate production ( Sieker and Zarrieß, 2026 ) . When model production is studied, the usual measure is frequency, with words and phrases that are over-represented relative to human text treated as targets for suppression ( Juzek and Ward, 2025 ; Paech et al., 2025 ) . Frequency answers the last of Hymes’s questions, how often an expression is in fact produced. For expressions with a legitimate function, it conflates appropriate and inappropriate uses, and suppression removes both. Whether models command appropriateness itself remains to be examined.
blocks.zh: 然而,关于语言模型的研究大多从听众方面接近了实用性,测试模型是否恢复了牵连和预想(Ruis等,2023;Hu等,2023;Sravanthi等,2024),最近的比较表明,理解能力不会转移到适当的生产(Sieker和Zarrieß,2026)。 在研究模型制作时,通常的量度是频率,相对于人文文字的词和词被过度代表作为压制目标(Juzek和Ward,2025;Paech等,2025.). Hymes的最后一个问题, 对于具有合法功能的表达方式,它综合了适当和不适当的使用,而压制则消除了两者。 模型命令是否适当本身尚待审查。

blocks.en: We examine this question through corrective negation, which denies one alternative and asserts another in its place. Its English form, it’s not X, it’s Y , is regularly cited as a hallmark of chatbot writing ( Oremus, 2026 ) , and Chinese online commentary singles out the Mandarin bushi X, ershi Y (‘not X, but Y’; 不是X，而是Y) in the same way, chiefly because the rejected X often appears to be a position that no one has taken. 1 1 1 For example, https://blog.darkthread.net/blog/ai-slop-not-but-pattern/ . Corrective negation is also the ordinary way to correct a misconception. Each use of the construction thus raises the two questions behind Grice’s maxims (Figure 1 ): whether the context made X a live alternative (relevance), and whether rejecting X contributes information not already established (quantity). We ask whether models, like competent speakers, know when the construction is called for.
blocks.zh: 我们通过纠正否定来审查这一问题,否定一种选择,并主张另一种选择。 它的英语形式不是X,而是Y, 经常被引用为聊天机器人写作的标志(Oremus, 2026), 而中文在线评论则以同样的方式将普通话的bushi X, ershi Y("不是X,而是Y";"Q","Q","Y")单独列出来,这主要是因为被拒绝的X经常是没有人采取的立场. 1 1 例如,https://blog.darkthread.net/blog/ai-slop-n-but-pattern/ 。 。 。 。 纠正否定也是纠正误解的平凡方式。 因此,对构筑物的每一次使用都提出了Grice所著通则背后的两个问题(图1):上下文是否使X成为活的替代物(相关性),拒绝X是否提供了尚未确定的信息(数量)。 我们问,像有能力的发言者一样,模型是否知道何时需要建造。

blocks.en: Linguistic theory makes these questions precise as conditions on licensing. As a construction, bushi X, ershi Y conventionally pairs its form with a corrective function ( Goldberg, 2006 ; Shao and Wang, 2010 ; Zuo, 2025 ) . The correction presupposes alternatives that contrast along a shared dimension ( Rooth, 1992 ) , and X need not have been asserted by anyone as long as it is accessible in the common ground ( Toosarvandani, 2013 ; Stalnaker, 2002 ) . What is rejected may be a proposition or the manner in which it is expressed, as in metalinguistic negation ( Horn, 1985 ) , and whether the correction is informative depends on the question under discussion ( Roberts, 2012 ) . These accounts separate three cases that are formally identical: a correction that resolves a live alternative, one that is well formed but unneeded, and one that is defective because it rejects something true or misattributes a view.
blocks.zh: 语言理论使这些问题成为颁发许可证的条件。 作为构型,bushi X,ershi Y在常规上将它的形态配以矫正功能(Goldberg,2006;Shao and Wang,2010;Zuo,2025). 校正预设了与共同维度形成对比的替代方案(Rooth,1992年),只要在共同点上可以获得,X就不需要任何人断言(Tosarvandani,2013年;Stalnaker,2002年)。 被否决的可能是一项命题或表达方式,如金属语否定(Horn, 1985年),更正是否内容翔实取决于所讨论的问题(Roberts, 2012年)。 这些账目将三种形式上相同的案例分开:一种解决活的替代品的更正,一种形成良好但不需要的更正,以及一种缺陷,因为它拒绝某种真实的事物或错误地分配了一种观点。

blocks.en: We introduce a diagnostic framework built around an ordered decision tree (Figure 2 ) that sorts each use of the construction into these three cases, first screening out defective uses and then testing the relevance and quantity conditions; a use that passes both is substantive, and one that fails either is optional. We apply the tree to answers from five commercial models on Chinese prompts and compare their usage with a human reference. We then investigate the sources of this preference, scoring each answer against minimally edited counterparts with reward models and an LLM judge, and tracing the construction’s frequency across training stages of open-weight models and in public preference data.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个诊断框架,它围绕一个有序的决定树(图2),将建筑的每一种用途分类到这三种情况下,首先筛选出有缺陷的用途,然后测试其相关性和数量条件;通过这两种用途都是实质性的,而失败的则是选择性的。 我们用这棵树来回答五种中国活字标注的商业模型 并将它们的用法与人类的参考物进行比较 然后,我们调查这种偏好的来源,将每个答案评分给最少经过编辑的对应方,以奖励模型和一位LLM法官,并追踪建筑在开放量模型培训阶段的频率以及公共偏好数据。

blocks.en: For a substantial share of uses, models do not. They use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as the human reference, and the shortfall lies in appropriateness more than in correctness, with only 1.30% of annotated uses defective and 52.8% classified as optional. Several reward models favor the construction even when variants match in general quality, and an LLM judge favors it even where the context does not license it. Along the training pipelines of open-weight models, both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization tend to raise its frequency.
blocks.zh: 就很大一部分用途而言,模型没有。 他们使用的构件是人类参考材料的2.5至9.2倍,不足在于适当性,而不是正确性,只有1.30%的注解用途有缺陷,52.8%被列为可选用途。 有几个奖励模式倾向于构建,即使变体与一般质量相符,一个LLM法官也倾向于构建,即使上下文不许可。 在开放重量型号的培训管道沿线,监督的微调和优惠优化都倾向于提高其频率。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We formalize stylistic tics in LLM-generated text as a failure of appropriateness in the sense of communicative competence. • We distinguish uses that are correct from uses that are needed, and operationalize this distinction as a decision tree derived from linguistic theory. • We provide a method for diagnosing how reward models and training stages shape the preference for such expressions.
blocks.zh: - 我们的捐助如下: 在LLM生成的文本中,我们正式确定形式论,认为在交流能力意义上是不适当的。 我们区分正确用途和必要用途,并将这种区分作为源于语言理论的决策树加以实施。 我们提供了一种方法,用以诊断奖励模式和培训阶段如何决定人们对这种表达的偏好。

blocks.en: We formalize stylistic tics in LLM-generated text as a failure of appropriateness in the sense of communicative competence.
blocks.zh: 在LLM生成的文本中,我们正式将语义学的字典化为沟通能力意义上的不适当.

blocks.en: We distinguish uses that are correct from uses that are needed, and operationalize this distinction as a decision tree derived from linguistic theory.
blocks.zh: 我们把正确的用途与需要的用途区分开来,并将这种区分作为来自语言理论的决策树加以实施。

blocks.en: We provide a method for diagnosing how reward models and training stages shape the preference for such expressions.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了一种方法,用以诊断奖励模式和培训阶段如何决定人们对这种表达的偏好。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work draws on three lines of research. Studies of language models as speakers identify which expressions models overproduce; linguistic accounts of corrective negation specify when the construction is appropriate; and work on evaluator bias suggests where a preference for it may originate.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作借鉴了三行研究. 对作为发言者的语言模型进行研究,确定哪些表达模型生产过多;纠正否定的语言叙述具体说明何时适宜构建;关于评价者偏好的研究表明,其偏好可能源于何处。

blocks.en: 2.1 Language Models as Speakers
blocks.zh: 2.1 语文模式作为发言者

blocks.en: Research on language models has examined their pragmatic competence and their characteristic output largely in isolation. Pragmatic evaluations have mostly taken the listener’s side, testing whether models recover implicatures and presuppositions ( Ruis et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Sravanthi et al., 2024 ) or recognize constructional meaning ( Weissweiler et al., 2022 ) . The speaker’s side has a longer history in generation, where Gricean maxims constrain referring expressions ( Dale and Reiter, 1995 ) and pragmatic speakers reason about a listener in reference games ( Frank and Goodman, 2012 ; Andreas and Klein, 2016 ) , though in tasks whose communicative goal is fixed in advance. Studies of open-ended model writing instead focus on its characteristic expressions, including over-represented words ( Juzek and Ward, 2025 ; Kobak et al., 2025 ) , recurring syntactic templates ( Shaib et al., 2024 ) , and broader measures of low-quality “slop” ( Shaib et al., 2025 ) , with suppression proposed as a remedy ( Paech et al., 2025 ) . These studies establish which expressions models produce too often, which is a matter of frequency.
blocks.zh: 对语言模式的研究主要孤立地审查了其实用能力及其特征产出。 实事求是的评价大多站在听众的一边,测试模型是否恢复了隐患和预想(Ruis等,2023;Hu等,2023;Sravanthi等,2024)或是否承认了构建意义(Weissweiler等,2022)。 演讲者一方在一代人中有着更悠久的历史,Gricean的口号制约了引用表达(Dale and Reiter,1995年)和实用的演讲者解释参考游戏中的收听者(Frank and Goodman,2012年;Andreas and Klein,2016年),尽管在任务中,沟通目标提前确定. 对无限制模式书写的研究则侧重于其特征表达,包括代表过多的词(Juzek和Ward,2025;Kobak等,2025;反复出现的合成模板(Shaib等,2024;和较广泛的低质量 " slop " 衡量标准(Shaib等,2025;)),并提议压制作为一种补救办法(Paech等,2025)。 这些研究确定了哪些表达模型产生频率太高,这是频率问题.

blocks.en: 2.2 Corrective Negation
blocks.zh: 2.2 纠正性否认

blocks.en: Corrective negation is well described in both English and Mandarin, and these descriptions specify when a speaker uses it appropriately. The construction denies one alternative and asserts another in its place. Work on English shows that it presupposes alternatives contrasting along a shared dimension and can target the form of an utterance as well as its content ( Horn, 1985 ; Toosarvandani, 2013 ) . Studies of bushi … ershi describe the same corrective function in Mandarin. Shao and Wang (2010) identify a pseudo-denial use, in which the negation does not retract any claim held in the context; Tan (2016) compares the construction with English not A but B and finds both semantic and metalinguistic correction in each; and Zuo (2025) analyzes ershi as the connective that lexicalizes correction, distinct from those for contrast and adversative relations. We turn these descriptions into conditions for assessing each use in model output.
blocks.zh: 纠正否定在英语和普通话中都有很好的描述,这些描述规定了一个发言者何时适当使用. 该建筑否认了一种替代办法,并主张替代另一种替代办法。 关于英语的研究表明,它预先假定了在共同层面形成对比的替代办法,并且可以针对言论的形式及其内容(Horn, 1985;Toosarvandani, 2013.). 研究Bushi... ershi在普通话中描述同样的矫正功能. Shao和Wang(2010年)确定了一种伪否认的使用,其中否定者不撤回任何在上下文中持有的主张;Tan (2016年) 将构造与英文(不是A而是B)进行比较,发现每个词都有语义和金属化的校正;Zuo (2025年) 分析ershi是将校正语化的连通性,区别于对比和逆向关系. 我们把这些描述变成评估模型产出中每种用途的条件。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluator Bias
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价员

blocks.en: The evaluators used to train and assess language models are biased toward surface features of responses, and training can carry these biases into model output. Reward models and LLM judges favor longer responses ( Singhal et al., 2024 ) , list formatting ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and style more broadly ( Wu and Aji, 2025 ) , and LLM judges show position and verbosity biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Preference optimization also narrows the range of model outputs ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) , and open post-training pipelines that release intermediate checkpoints make it possible to trace such changes stage by stage ( Lambert et al., 2024 ; OLMo et al., 2025 ) . Unlike length or formatting, a corrective construction’s appropriateness depends on context; the question is whether evaluators and training favor it only where it is called for.
blocks.zh: 用于培训和评估语言模型的评价人员偏向于反应的表面特征,培训可以将这些偏差带入模型输出. 奖励模型和LLM评委赞成较长的答复(Singhal等,2024年),列表格式化(Zhang等,2025年),风格更宽泛(Wu and Aji,2025年),LLM评委表现出立场和动词偏差(Zheng等,2023年). 优惠优化还缩小了模型输出范围(Kirk等,2024年),开放后培训管道释放出中间检查站,从而有可能按阶段追踪这种变化(Lambert等,2024年;OLMo等,2025年)。 与长度或格式不同,纠正性构建的适当性取决于背景;问题在于评估者和培训人员是否只在需要时才赞成。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: We propose a diagnostic framework that assesses each use of the construction by whether its context calls for it, rather than by how often it occurs. Its core is a decision tree, derived from corrective negation and Gricean pragmatics, that labels each occurrence as substantive, optional, or defective. We pair these labels with frequency measures, evaluator comparisons, and checkpoint analyses to trace the sources of the preference.
blocks.zh: 我们建议建立一个诊断框架,评估建筑的每一种用途,即其背景是否要求建筑,而不是其发生频率。 其核心是决策树,来源于纠正否定和Gricean实用主义,将每次发生都标为实质性、可选或有缺陷。 我们把这些标签与频率测量、评估比较和检查站分析相配,以追踪偏好的来源。

blocks.en: 3.1 Analytical Criteria
blocks.zh: 3.1 分析标准

blocks.en: We operationalize contextual appropriateness through corrective meaning and discourse contribution. A descriptive reading approximates ¬ p X ∧ p Y \neg p_{X}\land p_{Y} ; metalinguistic negation rejects wording or degree ( Horn, 1985 ) , while reframing replaces an explanatory perspective. Alternatives share a recoverable contrast dimension ( Rooth, 1992 ; Toosarvandani, 2013 ) , and their availability differs from a participant’s endorsement ( Stalnaker, 2002 ) . Grice’s Relation and Quantity maxims motivate separate tests of contextual licensing and informative contribution; Manner motivates checking interpretability ( Grice, 1975 ) . We assess contribution against the current question under discussion (QUD), which tracks the distinctions still open in the discourse ( Roberts, 2012 ) . For instance, the bottleneck is not the CPU, but disk I/O is licensed and informative when the user reports that upgrading the CPU did not help; it is unlicensed when nothing has raised the CPU, and redundant when the answer has already ruled the CPU out.
blocks.zh: 我们通过纠正意义和言论贡献来落实环境适当性。 描述性读取近似于 ¬ p X ∧ p Y\neg p_{X}\ _{ _{ _{ _{ ; 金属学否定否定  rejects (Horn, 1985) ,而再定义代替了解释性的观点. 替代品具有可回收的对比度(Rooth,1992;Toosarvandani,2013),其可用性不同于参与者的认可(Stalnaker,2002)。 Grice的"关系和数量"(Relations and Question maximes)激发了对背景许可和资料性贡献的单独测试;Manual激励着检查可解释性(Grice,1975年). 我们对照目前讨论的问题(QUD)评估贡献,该议题跟踪了讨论中仍然存在的区别(Roberts,2012年)。 例如,瓶颈不是CPU,但当用户报告升级CPU没有帮助时磁盘I/O是许可和信息化的;当没有任何东西提升CPU时是无许可证的,当答案已经排除CPU时是多余的.

blocks.en: 3.2 An Evidence-Based Diagnostic Tree
blocks.zh: 3.2 循证诊断 树

blocks.en: The unit is one occurrence in its complete answer and available context. Annotators recover X/Y, reading, scope, commitment holder, and QUD, then follow Figure 2 , citing evidence at each visited node.
blocks.zh: 单位是其完整答案和可用上下文中的一个发生. 注释者收回X/Y、读取、范围、承诺持有人和QUD,然后遵循图2,引用每个访问节点的证据。

blocks.en: T tests for factual conflict, contradiction, or invalid exclusion under the recovered reading. A tests whether the correction misattributes a position. P tests for inappropriate rejection or disrupted interpretation, requiring a target signal, an independent defect basis, and a specific consequence, such as obstructed reference or unjustified issue replacement. Missing motivation alone is assessed at L. The first positive finding assigns D (defective) .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Our experiments address two questions: whether models use the construction where it is called for, and where their preference for it comes from. We answer the first by comparing model and human usage in frequency and function, and the second by examining evaluator preferences, training stages, and public preference data.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及两个问题:模型是否使用它需要的构造,以及它们喜欢它来自何处。 我们通过比较模型和人类在频率和功能上的使用来回答第一个问题,第二个通过审查评价者偏好、培训阶段和公共偏好数据来回答这个问题。

blocks.en: 4.1 Frequency and Function
blocks.zh: 4.1 频率和函数

blocks.en: We examine 5,285 answers from five API models—GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, GLM, and Qwen—to 1,061 Chinese prompts drawn from AlignBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , WritingBench ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , COIG-CQIA ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , and Arena-Hard-v2 ( LMArena, 2026 ) . A human reference comprises community answers, examination responses, student essays, and role-play dialogue. We compare construction density per 10,000 Han characters, averaging equally over four shared task dimensions: professional ability, general question answering, Chinese understanding, and writing. Tables 2 and 3 summarize the human corpus and model generation panel; Appendix A provides the detection details.

blocks.en: Across the five models, density is 2.5–9.2 times the human reference (Figure 3 a). The human reference answers different prompts, and its detector also admits comma-free and cross-sentence forms that the model detector excludes; this detection difference, if anything, understates the gap. The construction is thus a recurrent choice across models, rather than a peculiarity of one system. Its local contribution is a separate question: frequent corrections may resolve an outstanding alternative, but they may also introduce a contrast the answer does not need.
blocks.zh: 在五个模型中,密度为人类参考值的2.5-9.2倍(图3a)。 人类参考解答了不同的提示,它的探测器也承认了模型探测器所排除的逗号解说和交叉判罚的形式;这种探测差异,如果有的话,低估了差距. 因此,这种构建是一种跨模型的反复选择,而不是一个系统的特殊性。 其局部贡献是一个单独的问题:频繁的更正可能解决一个悬而未决的替代办法,但它们也可能带来一个对比,而答案并不需要。

blocks.en: Of 308 selected occurrences, one cybersecurity-related item triggered a refusal from the Claude annotation service and yielded no valid label, leaving 307 occurrences for functional analysis in their full context. Labels were generated with claude-sonnet-5-5 and subsequently audited. Optional uses account for 52.8% of the 307 annotated cases (Figure 3 b,c; Table 4 ). Contextual licensing or issue advancement accounts for 96.4% of non-substantive decisions. The recurring problem is thus a correction introduced without a contextual reason, or repeated after its work has already been done. Only four occurrences are classified as defective.
blocks.zh: 在选定的308起事故中,1起与网络安全有关的事故引发克洛德注解服务的拒绝,没有给出有效的标签,使307起事故完全用于功能分析。 标签是用Claude-sonnet-5-5生成的,随后进行了审计。 任择用途占307起附加说明的案件的52.8%(图3b,c;表4)。 在非实质性决定中,背景许可或发放预付款占96.4%。 因此,反复出现的问题是在没有相关原因的情况下进行更正,或在工作完成后重复进行。 只有四起事件被列为有缺陷。

blocks.en: We apply the same tree to the human reference. Of its 38 detected occurrences, five are quoted or metalinguistic and are excluded before tree application. Among the remaining 33, 63.6% are substantive and 33.3% optional, compared with 45.9% and 52.8% in model answers (Figure 3 c). The difference is concentrated in unlicensed uses (12.1% vs. 24.1%); redundant uses differ less (21.2% vs. 28.0%). Models therefore not only use the construction more densely, but a larger share of their uses introduces an alternative that the context gives no reason to reject (Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把同一棵树用在人类身上 在38起被检测出的事件中,有5起被引用或被金属化,在施用树木之前被排除在外。 在其余的33个中,63.6%是实质性的,33.3%是可选的,而在模型答复中为45.9%和52.8%(图3c)。 差异主要集中在无许可证用途(12.1%对24.1%);多余用途差异较小(21.2%对28.0%)。 因此,模型不仅使用更密集的构造,而且其用途的较大份额引入了一种上下文没有理由拒绝的替代品(附录A.1.)。

Reordering preserves the rejected alternative; affirmative-only editing removes it. Five reward models score full question–answer pairs. Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-sol apply the same pairwise rubric in both presentation orders, yielding mean ordinal preference scores from 0 to 1, with .5 indicating a tie. Three of GPT’s 1,204 planned judgments were blocked by the provider’s content filter on one item. General-quality scores provide a further comparison among variants receiving identical scores on every applicable dimension (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: FsfairX ( Dong et al., 2024 ) , Skywork ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and OffsetBias ( Park et al., 2024 ) prefer the original order in 68.3–76.8% of non-tied optional-use comparisons (Figure 4 a). ArmoRM ( Wang et al., 2024 ) shows a weaker preference, whereas InternLM2 ( Cai et al., 2024 ) favors the reordered version. The result identifies a recurring preference in three evaluators: they reward the original realization even where the tree classifies the correction as optional.
blocks.zh: FsfairX(Dong等,2024年),Skywork(Liu等,2025年),和OffsetBias(Park等,2024年)在68.3%-76.8%的非tied可选用途比较中更倾向于原来的顺序(图4 a). ArmoRM(Wang等,2024年)显示偏好较弱,而InternLM2(Cai等,2024年)则倾向于重排版本. 结果确定了三个评价者反复出现的偏好:它们奖励原始实现,即使树将校正归类为可选.

blocks.en: For corrections without contextual licensing, Claude Sonnet 5.5 prefers the original over the affirmative-only answer (mean score 0.630) and over reordering (0.563; Figure 4 c; Table 7 ). GPT-6.1-sol shows weaker but directionally consistent preferences (0.519 and 0.517, respectively). Critically, neither judge’s preference varies with corrective function: substantive-minus-unlicensed differences are 0.002 and 0.005 for Claude, and − 0.002 -0.002 and − 0.001 -0.001 for GPT; all four 95% intervals include zero (Figure 4 d). This insensitivity indicates that both judges reward the construction’s surface form regardless of whether the context licenses it.
blocks.zh: 对于没有上下文许可的更正,克洛德·索内特5.5倾向于原作而不是只肯定的回答(平均得分0.630)和重排(0.563;图4c;表7)。 GPT-6.1-溶液显示较弱但方向一致的偏好(分别为0.519和0.517). 关键的是,法官的偏好与纠正功能不同:Claude的实质性差值为0.002和0.005;GPT的差值为0.002-0.002和0.001;所有4个95%的间隔都是零(图4d)。 这种不敏感的态度表明,两位法官都奖励建筑的地表形态,而不管其背景是否许可。

blocks.en: To examine whether reward models’ preference for the original order is associated with general answer quality, we retain original–reordered pairs with identical scores on every applicable quality dimension. Excluding reward-model ties, FsfairX, Skywork, and OffsetBias still prefer “not X, but Y” over “Y, not X” in 73.1–78.3% of comparisons (Table 6 ). Thus, these three reward models exhibit an ordering preference even when the quality scores do not distinguish the two versions.
blocks.zh: 为了检查奖励模式对原顺序的偏好是否与一般答题质量有关,我们保留了每个适用质量维度上相同分数的原-重排配对. 除奖励模式关系外,FsairX、Skywork和OffsetBias在73.1%-78.3%的比较中仍然倾向于 " 不是X,而是Y " 而不是 " Y " (表6)。 因此,这三种奖励模式都表现出了订单偏好,即使质量分数没有区分两种版本.

blocks.en: Table 1 presents two sports answers differing mainly in whether context supplies X. In a victory speech by a swimmer long troubled by injury, the finish is what a new champion would naturally recall, and the injury motivates setting it aside. In commentary on Messi’s World Cup title, no one suggests that the title amounts merely to winning; the target raises this view only to reject it, although winning the final is precisely what the title is.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了两个主要在上下文是否提供X方面不同的体育答案。 在一位长期受伤害困扰的游泳运动员的胜利演讲中,结局是一位新冠军自然会记得的,而伤害激励着将它搁置一旁. 在对梅西世界杯冠军头衔的评论中,没有人建议该头衔只相当于取胜;目标提出这个观点只是为了拒绝它,尽管决赛的取胜恰恰就是取名.

blocks.en: Yet the LLM judge favors the original in every judgment for both answers except one tie. For Messi, it concedes that the sentence is “slightly odd logically” and still prefers it because it “reads smoothly and passionately.” FsfairX and Skywork also score the original above the reordered version in both cases. The evaluators reward the construction’s rhetorical effect, not whether the context raises the rejected alternative.
blocks.zh: 然而LLM法官在每次判决中都倾向于原作,除了一个比分之外,两个答案都偏好. 对于梅西来说,它承认这句话“逻辑上有点奇怪”,并且仍然更喜欢它,因为它“读得平稳而热情地”。 FsfairX和Skywork在两种情况下还得分上方重排版本的正本. 评估者奖励建筑的修辞效果,而不是背景是否提出了被拒绝的替代方案。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Frequency and appropriateness are separate properties of model usage. Models produce the construction far more often than people do, and many of these uses are correct but not called for. Evaluators do not supply the missing judgment: several reward models prefer the construction after general-quality matching, and both judges prefer it within unlicensed uses. In the available checkpoints, its density also rises through SFT and DPO. Suppressing the form would remove its appropriate uses along with the rest; reducing tics of this kind requires evaluation and training signals that register whether an expression is called for. The diagnostic is not specific to Mandarin: screening for defects and then testing contextual licensing and issue advancement can be applied to English it’s not X, it’s Y and to other expressions that are legitimate in some contexts and overused in others.
blocks.zh: 频率和适当性是模型使用的不同特性。 模型造型远比人们制造的要多,其中许多用途是正确的,但并不需要. 评价者不提供缺失的判断:几个奖励模式倾向于在一般质量匹配后进行构建,两个法官都倾向于在无证使用范围内进行构建. 在现有的检查站,其密度也通过SFT和DPO提高。 将表格与其余表格一起销毁其适当用途;要减少此类词汇,就需要评价和培训信号,以记录是否需要表达。 诊断不是普通话特有的:筛选缺陷,然后测试背景许可和问题推进,可以应用到英语中,不是X,而是Y,以及在某些情况下合法、在另一些情况下被过度使用的其他表达方式。

blocks.en: A controlled follow-up can test this attribution by holding SFT initialization, source composition, update budget, and prompts fixed, intervening on construction-bearing preference pairs with matched edits, and repeating training across seeds. Measuring activation, repetition, and local function would then separate changes in how often the construction is selected from changes in what it contributes.
blocks.zh: 受控的后续工作可以通过持有 SFT 初始化,源组成,更新预算,并固定提示,介入有构造的首选配对并进行匹配的编辑,以及跨种子重复训练来测试这种归属. 测量活性、重复和局部功能,然后将构造的选择频率与其贡献的变化分开。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our analysis covers five commercial models, a limited set of task domains, and 307 annotated uses. Broader models, domains, and human data would strengthen the estimates.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析包括五个商业模式、一组有限的任务领域和307个附加说明的用途。 更广泛的模型、领域和人类数据将加强估计。

blocks.en: The checkpoint and preference-data comparisons are observational, so they show that frequency rises along training pipelines but do not establish which stage or data causes the rise. Controlled retraining is needed to test this attribution.
blocks.zh: 检查点和偏好数据比较是观察性的,因此它们表明,培训管道沿线的频率上升,但没有确定哪个阶段或数据导致上升。 需要有控制的再培训来检验这种归属。

blocks.en: We assess appropriateness through linguistic criteria and do not measure how readers perceive the construction. Whether unneeded uses cause annoyance or affect comprehension requires a separate user study.
blocks.zh: 我们通过语言标准评估适当性,而不衡量读者对构思的看法。 是否需要使用引起烦恼或影响理解,需要单独进行一次用户研究。

blocks.en: We study a single Mandarin construction. Although the decision tree is designed to transfer to English it’s not X, it’s Y and other recurring expressions, we have not applied it beyond bushi X, ershi Y .
blocks.zh: 我们研究的是单一普通话建筑. 虽然决策树旨在向英文转移, 它不是X, 是Y和其他反复出现的表达方式,

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This section discusses the ethical considerations and broader impact of this work.
blocks.zh: 本节讨论这项工作的道德考虑和更广泛的影响。

blocks.en: The decision tree describes when a corrective construction is called for, and this description could be used to make model-written text resemble human writing more closely and thus harder to identify. Conversely, the frequency measures could be misread as evidence of machine authorship and applied to judge human writers, who also use the construction. Our analyses concern aggregate usage across models and corpora; they are not designed or validated for attributing individual texts to humans or machines.
blocks.zh: 决策树描述了何时需要纠正的构造,这种描述可以用来使模型-书面文本更接近于人书写,从而更难被识别. 反之,频率测量可能被误读为机器著作权的证据并被应用于判断人类作家,而人类作家也使用构造. 我们的分析涉及各种模型和公司的整体使用;这些模型的设计或验证不是为了将单个文本归于人类或机器。

blocks.en: The benchmarks, open-weight checkpoints, reward models, and preference mixtures used in this work are publicly released for research, and we use them in accordance with their respective licenses. Commercial models are accessed through their official APIs under the providers’ terms of service. All materials are used solely for scientific research.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中使用的基准、开放的检查站、奖励模式和优惠混合物被公开用于研究,我们根据各自的许可证加以使用。 根据供应商的服务条件,通过官方API获取商业模型。 所有材料只用于科学研究。

blocks.en: The human reference is drawn from publicly available datasets, and personally identifiable information was removed before analysis. Model answers are generated from public benchmark prompts. The human annotators are students with a background in linguistics who participated voluntarily; no personal information about them is collected beyond their annotations.
blocks.zh: 人类参考文献取自公开的数据集,在分析前删除了个人识别信息. 模型解答来自公共基准提示. 人类的注释者是具有语言学背景的学生,他们自愿参加;关于他们的个人信息没有收集到说明之外。

blocks.en: The diagnostic framework is intended for analyzing contextual appropriateness in model-generated text and for examining how evaluators and training stages shape such usage. It is not intended for authorship detection or for evaluating individual writers.
blocks.zh: 诊断框架旨在分析模型生成的案文中的背景适宜性,并审查评估人员和培训阶段如何形成这种使用。 它不用于作者身份的检测或评价个人作家。

blocks.en: We will release our code and the annotation guidelines for the decision tree. Both are documented with respect to their scope: the Mandarin construction bushi X, ershi Y , the task domains covered, and the procedures described in Appendices A – D .
blocks.zh: 我们将发布我们的代码 和注释指南 决策树。 两者的范围都有文献记载:普通话建筑 Bushi X, ershi Y, 涵盖的任务领域以及附录A-D所描述的程序.

blocks.en: A.1 Functional Annotation and Human Comparison

blocks.en: The sample comprises 308 selected response groups. One cybersecurity-related item triggered a refusal from the Claude annotation service and yielded no valid label; the functional analysis therefore covers 307 annotated targets. Labels were generated with claude-sonnet-5-5 and subsequently audited. Annotation excludes templates, purely metalinguistic quoted strings, and known incomplete materials. Annotators assess the original response without edited variants or evaluator scores, recover the supported reading and question under discussion, and record factual uncertainty separately. An implicit question under discussion requires contextual evidence independent of the target contrast.
blocks.zh: 样本包括308个选定的反应小组。 一个与网络安全有关的项目引发克洛德注解服务的拒绝,没有给出有效的标签;因此功能分析涵盖307个附加说明的目标。 标签是用Claude-sonnet-5-5生成的,随后进行了审计。 注释不包括模板,纯粹是被取自的金属活字串和已知的不完整材料. 注释者在没有编辑变体或评价分数的情况下评估原始答复,恢复正在讨论的支持读取和问题,并分别记录事实不确定性。 讨论中隐含的问题需要独立于目标对比的上下文证据。

blocks.en: The annotated sample contains 141 substantive, 162 optional, and four defective uses (Table 4 ). blocks.en: We compare annotations from two independent human annotators, both with a background in linguistics, on the same 100 cases (Table 5 ). Terminal-label agreement requires the full classification, including the subtype when applicable, to match. Both annotators labeled the cases independently without consensus discussion. The κ \kappa values indicate moderate agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . The expected drop at the terminal level reflects the inherent difficulty of distinguishing fine-grained pragmatic subcategories (e.g., O L O_{L} vs. O U O_{U} ), even for trained linguists.

blocks.en: Local inference for the open-weight checkpoints and reward models used NVIDIA A800 and H800 GPUs, totaling 8.35 A800 GPU hours and 17.07 H800 GPU hours. Checkpoint generation used vLLM 0.11.0 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . Reward-model scoring used the Hugging Face Transformers 4.56.1 implementations ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) with PyTorch 2.8.0 ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) and CUDA 12.8. The five commercial models, the annotation model, and both pairwise judges were accessed through their providers’ APIs. Decoding settings for the checkpoint panel are given in Appendix C , and those for the API panel in Appendix A .
